## Batch 8 complete

I authored 19 A-page items and 7 examples, with their manifests, contracts, coverage, notes, and readiness records. The pages remain drafts: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-optimization-inverse-problems-and-uncertainty-quantification/rare-event-importance-sampling-and-multilevel-splitting.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-optimization-inverse-problems-and-uncertainty-quantification/rare-event-importance-sampling-and-multilevel-splitting-examples.md).

The proposed SIR bound based only on squared conditional future means is false; the two-state counterexample shows its right side can be zero while the exact MSE is \(1/(4N)\). I also proved a separate absolute bound, \(\mathbb E[(\widehat p-P(A_L))^2]\le (L+1)/(4N)\), for bounded potentials under full resampling. The owner-controlled contract still needs amendment; I recorded the evidence and requested repair in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-8.notes.md), without editing the shared plan.
